title: a saved worker may list only approved subagents, a draft subagent included; a draft worker may list draft subagents but still not a candidate or retired one
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). A subagent's prompt reaches `claude --agents`, so only reviewed text may. A saved (approved) worker whose listed subagent is a draft is `JITSO REJECTED: build "<worker>" lists subagent "<subagent>", which is draft, not approved`. A draft worker may list a draft subagent (the dry run prints the card), and a draft worker that lists a saved `candidate` subagent is rejected like any worker.

files..jitso/briefs/brief.md:
## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Do not change any file and do not leave the repository.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
